# Test Fixtures

This directory contains test assets for automated testing.

## Required Files

### Audio Files
- `test-audio.mp3` - Short audio file for testing audio playback and analysis
  - Recommended: 10-30 seconds of music with clear beats
  - Can use any royalty-free audio

### How to Add Test Audio
1. Find a short royalty-free audio clip (MP3 format)
2. Rename it to `test-audio.mp3`
3. Place it in this directory

## Notes
- Keep test files small (< 1MB) for fast test execution
- Do not commit copyrighted audio files
